title: Leela cleans muddy pond water
body: Leela was working on the farm with her father when she realised they had left their drinking water at home. She went to a nearby pond and filled a container, but the water was muddy and unfit for drinking. She first kept the container undisturbed for some time. Then, without shaking it, she gently poured the upper water through a folded muslin cloth into a clean pan. Next, she boiled the water for about ten minutes in the covered pan and let it cool. Finally, she filtered it once more through a clean cloth before serving it to her father.
